articles.summary: All of our documentation is now open source so that you can contribute to it if you'd like and so that we can improve on it in public.
articles.title: Depot documentation is now open source

articles.summary: Today we're announcing local Docker image builds with the speed of Depot's cloud builders and instant cache sharing across your entire team.
articles.title: Accelerated local builds, with instant shared cache

articles.summary: We're excited to announce that you can now lint your Dockerfile on every build with Depot! No more configuring a separate Dockerfile linter outside or before your build in CI.
articles.title: Lint a Dockerfile on every build

articles.summary: There are four fundamentals to building a Docker image quickly with docker build. From the moment we create a Dockerfile, we should be thinking about the fundamentals of building a Docker image as fast as possible.
articles.title: The fundamentals of building a Docker image
